title: Classic Turkish Doner Kebab
description: A traditional Turkish dish made with thinly sliced lamb and served in a crusty roll with vegetables and sauce.
instructions: Preheat a vertical spit or a grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the lamb into thin strips and season with salt and black pepper.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, if using.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the pita bread on the grill or in a toaster.
Assemble the kebabs by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita bread, followed by a few slices of lamb, some onion, tomato, and lettuce.
